maddeler.e:
احسس (form I)
# اُحْسُسْ (uḥsus) /uħ.sus/: second-person masculine singular imperative of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to freeze; to curry (a horse)”)
# اِحْسِسْ (iḥsis) /iħ.sis/: second-person masculine singular imperative of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to be moved with compassion”)
# اِحْسَسْ (iḥsas) /iħ.sas/: second-person masculine singular imperative of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to feel, to perceive”)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
